basic_profile.bio: I'm a lifelong Minnesota Timberwolves fan living in Long Island. I work as a software developer, which gives me the flexibility to keep up with games and interact online during late evenings and weekends. When I'm not watching basketball or coding, I enjoy off-roading with my Jeep and tinkering with DIY projects. I'm in a long-term relationship with my girlfriend, who graciously tolerates my sports obsession.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for a few years. My knowledge of basketball comes from years of following the Timberwolves and participating in various online sports forums. I also engage in DIY projects as a hobby, which is how I found my way into the Jeep and DIY communities.
